description: This source file defines a utility function to order a list of file paths based on their relative position within a specified root directory. It includes a data structure for holding file path information, and a function that computes relative paths, sorts them alphabetically, and returns the ordered list of file paths.

classes.name: orderedFile
classes.description: A struct to hold the original file path and its relative path for sorting purposes.

methods.name: orderFiles
methods.description: Takes a root directory and a list of file paths, converts each to an absolute and relative path, sorts them alphabetically by relative path, and returns the ordered list.
